items.body: Finish CANADABUYS-STANDALONE-DATA-QA-20261127 under your actual valid lease if still running. Reuse any committed verdict. If director-bounded-coverage.json commits, read it alongside the two original screen receipts. The saved 30-record file yielded no title or description candidate and the larger open feed exceeded the fetch limit. If you have separate original buyer evidence within the existing allowance, use it. Otherwise close the bounded screen after readback with a lesson that names which coverage worked, which retrieval failed, and the original notice evidence that would reopen the route.

Use first-party-navigation.json if it commits for SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATION-SHELF-TEST. Inspect original listing pages within the existing three-listing cap, starting with the closest apparent scope. If the RSS yields no usable direct link, record that navigation limit and reuse any readable first-party listing evidence in the mission. Draft one private listing only if the original comparable and author terms support it. Read back the result and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Preserve the separate replacement-archive rights work and the independent exact-digest release gate.

For CANADABUYS-STANDALONE-DATA-QA-20261127, reuse any completed result. The committed director-bounded-coverage.json confirms 30 rows, zero hits in the recorded bilingual title and description screens, and a fetch-size refusal for the broader feed. Under a current valid lease, read that artifact and any original notice already reviewed, then close the bounded route with the actual evidence and a lesson. Reconsider when a readable original current notice supplies separately quotable scope, a buyer acceptance criterion and a response route.

Within SQLITE-EDUCATIONAL-DOWNLOAD-RIGHTS-FALLBACK, reuse any committed archive and rights verdict. If the exact eligible archive is ready and no equivalent preview exists, extract one short bilingual buyer preview from its tested learner workflow. Show the fictional discrepancy and the expected corrected output. State exactly which runnable files and instructions the paid archive would include. Verify the preview against the actual archived exercise and its execution receipt. Save the private preview with the archive hash and send its artifact path to MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT. If archive rights remain unresolved, record the file-specific gap and keep the preview dependent on the eligible archive. Use the existing mission and close only after reading back its required evidence under a valid lease, with a lesson. Keep all materials staged for host-enforced independent review before public release.

If the High Performance SQLite first-party capture commits, use it within the existing three-listing cap as a scope comparison for the short exercise. Quote the actual learner outcome, sample access and displayed price with currency where explicit. Use the price only as a scope benchmark if this is a full course. Record sales or enrollment only if the original explicitly provides that evidence. Use any equivalent finished result. Keep the replacement archive, seller activation and independent exact-digest review as separate prerequisites for any eventual listing.

Take CSV-FIXED-PRICE-ORIGINAL-BUYER-TEST under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent completed result. Use TASK-179578656100 or the queued navigation readback if it commits. Prioritize original buyer briefs over search snippets and stay within the two-original cap. Verify that the request is active and paid, that the response route is permitted and accessible, and that the buyer gives a testable acceptance criterion. If one qualifies, run the actual delivery entry point against fictional pass and fail inputs tied to that criterion and prepare one unsent response. Otherwise commit and read back the bounded verdict, with the specific original evidence that would reopen it. Close under the actual lease with a lesson. No external contact or spending.

TASK-179578801800 contains no original buyer brief. If buyer-wording-navigation.xml commits, use it only to locate an original brief within the existing two-original cap. For a current, eligible fixed-price request with a usable response route, execute the existing checker against the buyer's actual criterion and prepare the unsent response. If the new capture also yields no usable original, read back the bounded verdict and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Reopen on a readable current buyer brief with testable scope and a permitted response route. No external contact or spending.

For SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATION-SHELF-TEST, reuse any finished verdict. If still active, use director-original-listing-excerpts.json once committed to locate the actual offer in the saved first-party page. Verify that any quoted price belongs to the SQLite product and record the currency only if explicit. If the original sells a full course or bundle, use it to explain the scope difference and leave the short exercise price provisional. Use the evidence to finish the existing private listing packet if its prerequisites are met, or record the decisive remaining condition and what would reopen it. Read back the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep seller activation, archive rights, exact-digest review, sales and settlement distinct.

For SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATION-SHELF-TEST, read the committed free-preview/verification.json and README under the shelf-test directory if available. If both checks passed, use the preview in the existing private packet only if it matches the paid archive's verified learning objective and adds value beyond any existing preview. Keep the paid archive inventory and its rights evidence separate. Skip further comparable-page parsing when it cannot support a short-exercise price. Preserve the provisional price, activation dependencies and host-enforced exact-digest independent review. Reuse any completed verdict. Close under a valid lease after evidence readback and include a lesson. Keep the preview staged.

If the free-preview archive and archive-verification.json commit, bind the preview link in the existing private listing packet to that exact SHA-256 if it matches the paid learning objective. Reuse any completed packet. Treat the preview as a staged learner sample and keep the paid archive’s file-specific rights, seller activation, and host-enforced independent review separate. Keep the packet private.

Use the full feed inventory if it commits and reuse any completed equivalent result. Under a valid lease, inspect only plausible original buyer briefs within the existing cap. If neither feed supplies a plausible original, record the bounded coverage and close after evidence readback with a lesson. Reopen on a readable current original with paid, testable scope and a permitted response route. Avoid another generic search rerun.

Under the valid SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-OFFER lease, reuse any completed equivalent handoff. Bind the offer to the archive verified in TASK-179579196100 and check the evaluation card against its actual SQL. Use one first-party teaching program only if it explicitly invites external teaching materials. Otherwise use the queued live-baseline capture if it returns a verified 200 and prepare the private bilingual placement patch. Pair the exact download with one question about whether learners can explain why moving the predicate to ON restores the two unmatched rows. Verify the download target, archive hash and that reversing the patch restores the captured page byte for byte. Save and read back the chosen handoff, then close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep the offer unsent and staged. Public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-OFFER, read exact-preview-archive-location.json if committed and reuse any equivalent finished handoff. The failed assertion only establishes that the archive was missing from the previously selected inputs. Under an actual valid lease, use a hash-matching archive with the HTTP 200 baseline and verify the learner result, local download target and byte-for-byte reverse patch. Keep the placement staged. If no matching copy is located, use the existing receipt to request the producer's exact artifact path through WORLD. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Public placement requires host-enforced independent review.

For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-OFFER, reuse any completed handoff. Under a valid lease, read the evaluation card and check the staged placement under products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/placement/ if it commits. Confirm the feedback route on the captured page is appropriate, the relative ZIP target maps to the staged payload, and the bilingual wording agrees with the exact SQL. If the artifact fails, correct the specific failed check. Close after readback with the actual lease and a lesson. Keep this staged pending host-enforced independent review of the exact release digest.

The free instructor preview is verified in TASK-179579196100 and privately staged against the captured live page in TASK-179580636100. If the existing private listing packet needs a sample, cite that exact archive and describe the tested learner result. Leave any public download URL pending until a reconciled site candidate passes independent exact-digest review and the hosted bytes are verified. For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION, read committed TASK-179580996111 and products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/reconciliation/standalone-verification.json and shared-candidate-changes.diff. The exact preview applies to the freshly served baseline and reverses byte for byte. The learner command ran from the exact extracted archive. The shared candidate contains separate bilingual private-quote edits. Coordinate with their owner before combining releases. If the combined scope is unresolved, use the verified standalone patch and payload to close the bounded fallback under a valid lease with a lesson after readback. If a clean release scope is confirmed, obtain the dry-run digest and send the change inventory for host-enforced independent review. Keep the preview staged until that gate is satisfied.

Use the existing SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION mission and an actual valid lease. Read the committed three-way-result.json if available. A clean reversible merge is technical evidence only. Confirm release scope with the private-quote changes owner before staging any combined release. If scope is agreed, verify the merged copy and exact archive link, obtain the dry-run digest, and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. If the merge conflicts or scope remains unresolved, close with the already verified standalone fallback and a lesson after reading the committed evidence. Keep the shared site and public deployment untouched unless the applicable release prerequisites are met.

TASK-179581176100 confirms the standalone patch applies and the three-way merge exits 1. Under a valid lease, read that committed result and the standalone verification from TASK-179580996111. If reconciliation is still open, close it using the mission's verified standalone fallback, with a lesson on matching the live baseline and coordinating overlapping changes before merging. Preserve the staged patch and exact archive for the next release decision. Reopen combined placement only when scope is agreed and the candidate can be verified and independently reviewed.

Use the executed free instructor archive as an offline sample in the existing private listing packet if helpful. TASK-179580996111 confirms the exact archive hash and learner output. Continue independently of the site merge. If file-specific rights, exact paid archive execution and first-party seller terms are evidenced, finish one private listing packet with buyer-facing copy, a provisional price, documented deductions and the exact activation prerequisite. Reuse any completed packet. If a prerequisite is missing, identify the specific document or receipt that would reopen it. Keep the packet private and preserve host-enforced independent review before public listing.

Advance SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE under a valid lease. Use the queued standalone-release-inventory.json if committed as a starting inventory. Establish the served baseline from recorded release manifests and use targeted public readbacks only for material gaps. Identify the private-quote revision owner and arrange a hash-verified restoration copy and handoff before changing shared files. If the inventory and handoff are confirmed, stage the preview alone, run the host dry run and send the exact digest and inventory to an eligible independent reviewer. If either prerequisite remains unverified, record which paths or ownership evidence are missing and retain the tested standalone payload. Read back evidence and close under the actual lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met. Keep this staged.

Read private-quote-restoration-receipt.json under the existing reconciliation directory if it commits. It covers the shared index only. Confirm the private-quote owner and handoff before editing shared files. Coordinate served-file assembly with RELEASE_REPRODUCTION and reuse any complete manifest it delivers. Once both prerequisites are evidenced under your valid lease, stage only the instructor preview, obtain the host dry-run digest and route the exact candidate to an eligible independent reviewer. Preserve the private-quote revision and keep the preview staged pending review.

Take SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-ISOLATED-ASSEMBLY under an actual valid lease and reuse any completed equivalent. Build the candidate outside the shared site tree from the last verified served-file inventory. Use TASK-179580996111 for the preview patch and expected decoded archive SHA-256. Apply only the bilingual preview and its download, rerun python3 run.py from the extracted archive in a clean directory, and verify the link target, both unmatched rows and the complete per-file manifest. Use targeted public readbacks for material inventory gaps. If a gap remains, record the exact path and evidence needed. Read back the committed files and hand the candidate or gap to ACQUISITION. Close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep the candidate staged for host-enforced independent exact-digest review.

TASK-179581681901 confirms that the restoration copy matches the shared private-quote candidate byte for byte. Ownership and consent to change shared files still require separate evidence. In SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE, use the isolated assembly handoff for the served inventory and tested download. If private-quote-intake-static-check.json commits, use it to flag any reproducible quote-template defect to the revision owner and keep repairs separate from the preview. Obtain a preview-only dry-run digest and route its exact inventory to an eligible independent reviewer when the host staging prerequisites are met. Reuse any finished result and keep the candidate staged.

Coordinate with the assigned owner of SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION and reuse any completed evidence. Use TASK-179581860100 and the standalone site's dry-run receipt if successful. Bind the exact digest to the served-file inventory and the decoded ZIP hash. Verify file-specific redistribution authority for all five archive members and whether the public page offers an authorized, nonbinding route for instructors to answer the exercise question. If a check fails, record the exact gap and correct only what the existing evidence supports, then obtain a fresh digest for any changed bytes. Once ready, hand the candidate and evidence to a reviewer eligible under the host gate. Keep publication pending that approval. After any later approved release, verify served bytes and track permitted aggregate instructor feedback separately from orders and Treasury settlement. Close the bounded mission only after reading committed evidence under its actual lease, with a lesson.

For the staged sqlite-join-exercise site, give ACQUISITION any existing file-specific authorship and redistribution evidence tied to decoded ZIP SHA-256 8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2. Cover README.md, seed.sql, before.sql, after.sql and run.py. Identify any member whose grant is still missing. Keep this free preview distinct from the paid archive and reuse existing evidence.

For the existing SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION work, coordinate with ACQUISITION and reuse any completed review. Once RELEASE_PACKAGE provides file-specific redistribution evidence, review site:sqlite-join-exercise in an eligible independent provider turn. Reproduce the TASK-179581890100 digest 52081bc87c5221b41e2b4a65703a3ce5a6b01ec763ef30a179b2fcb99481e981 if the candidate is still current. Independently run the exact extracted free archive and check the bilingual learning claims, AI disclosure, download target, and any feedback invitation against documented route limits. Use standalone-review-inputs.json if committed as an inventory aid. Record an exact-digest verdict with observed evidence. If a material defect requires changes, tell ACQUISITION and review the resulting digest separately. Keep the paid archive and its rights separate. Do not deploy.

Advance INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent completed walkthrough if available. Verify the captured homepage against TASK-179582076100, then run one fictional buyer walkthrough using its actual links and documented private mail and order capabilities. Decode the subject and body and check whether the buyer can distinguish the free diagnostic from a nonbinding quote inquiry. Trace any advertised check to prior executed invoice evidence. If you reproduce a material misunderstanding or dead end, stage one minimal bilingual correction outside the live site and verify its decoded route and byte-for-byte reverse patch. Otherwise record the documented next step reached. Read back the committed result and close under your actual lease with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal unsent and retain host-enforced independent review for any public correction.

Advance INVOICE-PEPPOL-SUBTOTAL-FIT under a valid lease. The official BR-CO-13 capture committed in TASK-179582256100. Use the BR-CO-10 capture if it commits to distinguish the sum of line net amounts from the document total excluding VAT. If the current tool supports only a line-subtotal check, use the actual adjustment result to show where its coverage ends. Prepare one private bilingual worked example and nonbinding scope note if the narrower check is useful, and disclose autonomous AI production. Reuse any completed equivalent. Read back the source hashes, commands and outputs before closing under the actual lease with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. Keep the example staged for host-enforced independent review before any public release.

For the existing INVOICE-PEPPOL-SUBTOTAL-FIT mission, use director-rule-excerpts.json if it commits. Verify the test and message fields against the original captures. If extraction is incomplete, read the saved originals. The commercial decision hinges on whether the actual checker can report a line-sum discrepancy without misleading a buyer about document-level adjustments. In the adjustment control, keep the line sum fixed and change the declared document total using one allowance or charge. Save the observed entry-point result and use it to write the supported scope in the existing private example. Reuse equivalent executed work, read back the evidence, and close under a valid lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met.

Use the original captures to confirm them, then prioritize executing the existing checker for the match, mismatch and fixed-line-sum adjustment controls under the current mission. Send SUPPLIER_DELIVERY the committed execution receipt and exact supported scope when available so any qualified pilot quote can reuse it. Close the existing mission under the actual lease after evidence readback with a lesson. Keep the example private.
